plugins.name: claude-council
plugins.description: Consult multiple AI coding agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, any model OpenRouter routes to, plus codex, antigravity, grok and kimi CLIs when installed, and a local ollama model) to get diverse perspectives on coding problems

plugins.name: claude-image-generation
plugins.description: Generate and edit images using Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT Image, xAI Grok Image, and OpenRouter APIs

plugins.name: claude-guard
plugins.description: Safety guardian that prevents Claude Code from executing dangerous commands, exposing secrets, and performing destructive operations

plugins.name: claude-tmux
plugins.description: Connect to remote hosts via SSH in tmux panes with saved host management, and run a repo's test suite on one of them

plugins.name: claude-taskmaster
plugins.description: Completion guard that prevents Claude from stopping prematurely. A Stop hook holds the turn open until Claude attests, via a TASKMASTER_DONE signal, that every item is done.

plugins.name: claude-crawl
plugins.description: Web search, fetch, and crawl via Jina AI, Cloudflare Browser Rendering, and Firecrawl

plugins.name: claude-release
plugins.description: Project-agnostic /release slash command. Drives version bump, tests, docs review, release-notes draft, approval gate, commit/push, and GitHub release. Auto-detects most projects; supports per-project release.config.json and lifecycle markdown extensions in .claude/release/.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, state pending offers once, give automated notices one line, make wins visible. Fork of ayghri/i-have-adhd.
